text: Perhaps there's hope for you after all. Our whole universe was in a hot dense state, and nearly fourteen billion years ago, expansion started. Wait, the Earth began to cool, the autotrophs began to drool, Neanderthals developed tools, we built a wall.

speaker: Unknown_speaker006
text: And now the pyramids, math, science, history, unraveling the mystery of all, started with a big bang.
